tools.name: extension_submit
tools.description: Submit a platform build to the Chrome, Firefox, Edge and Safari stores through extension.dev. Start with extension_submit_check action:'preflight' and follow value.nextStep. A real submit needs a workspace owner's token and approval of that exact submission, every time: extension_submit_check asks, and this tool runs the approvalId. Uploads land least public (Chrome and Edge drafts, Firefox unlisted, Safari TestFlight) unless a saved store mode says otherwise. For a link use extension_publish.
tools.gate: the server started with --features=local,platform, and a login; dryRun: false, cancel, rollout, release, publish, sync-listing and configure-store need a workspace owner's approval
tools.samplePrompt: Dry run a Chrome and Firefox store submission of the latest build

inputs.name: action
inputs.description: Per action: 'preflight', 'status' and submit with dryRun true (the default) are read-only; submit with dryRun:false and no approvalId executes nothing either, it only asks for the owner's approval, as does the first call of any store act; the approved approvalId runs it. submit: buildSha to the stores. preflight: readiness checks. status: each store's word. sync-listing: listing from STORE.md. publish (alias review): draft to review. release (Safari): approved version on sale. cancel: withdraw from review. rollout: raise Chrome's staged rollout. configure-store: storeSettings. connect: page where the person gives the platform the key. first-submission: page for a first Chrome or Edge upload. mint-signing (Safari): register the bundle id, mint certificates and profiles.
